action: Frank sits alone in the office after the last lesson of the day and writes two columns on a legal pad: 'What I teach' and 'How I teach.' The left column says: hand position, mirror checks, parallel parking, reading traffic. The right column says: reading anxiety in a student, breaking a complex skill into steps, building confidence in someone who wants to quit, knowing when to push and when to back off. He stares at the right column for a long time. He does not throw the pad away.
